title: Twitter Cyclone 3rd R7120 global specification
notes: Current exact global page lists 9.3 kg for both alloy- and carbon-wheel columns, high-modulus carbon frame/fork, Shimano 105 R7120 and fitted 700x28C tires. This conflicts with the simultaneously current 8.7 kg regional product page; neither publishes a manufacturer maximum tire clearance or complete weighing protocol.
